claude.text:
*scrolls slowly, squinting a bit*

Okay so... this looks like Astro is trying to get me to subscribe to one of their TV packs lah. Three options — Entertainment, Sports, Epic. Standard tiered pricing thing, I've seen this kind of layout before on Netflix and stuff.

First thing I notice — the Sports pack. Was RM89.99, now RM69.99. That one caught my eye immediately because I'm already using Sooka for football. So my brain goes, *eh, is this the same thing or different?* Like, does Sports pack include what I'm already getting free on Sooka, or is it more than that? The page says "Sooka Sports + Sports Extra" but I honestly don't know what Sports Extra means. Extra what? More channels? International football? No idea lah.

The Epic one is weird to me — RM159.99 but it *was* RM139.99? So the price went *up*? That's... not a good look. Why would I pay more than before? I'd need a very good reason for that.

Entertainment at RM49.99 — okay, the name doesn't tell me much. Entertainment can mean anything. Local dramas? Movies? International stuff? I genuinely cannot tell from just the name.

---

**Best value to me right now?** Probably the Sports pack at RM69.99 — purely because it *seems* related to what I already use Sooka for.

But honestly? I'm not confident at all in what I'd actually be getting. 

Like — do I need a dekoder box sent to my house? Is this streaming-only on the app? The page says "stream on up to 2 devices" so maybe it's app-based... but I'm not sure. That 12-month contract part also makes me hesitant. That's a commitment, bro.

And if I sign up for Sports — does that mean I *stop* seeing ads on Sooka? Or is Sooka separate? I have so many questions and none of them are answered just from looking at this.
